# Test that the correct default GOEXPERIMENT is used when cross
# building with BOLERO_ENV (#46815).

# Unset variables set by the TestScript harness. Users typically won't
# explicitly configure these, and #46815 doesn't repro if they are.
env GOOS=
env GOARCH=
env GOEXPERIMENT=

env BOLERO_ENV=windows-amd64
bolero build internal/abi

env BOLERO_ENV=ios-arm64
bolero build internal/abi

env BOLERO_ENV=linux-mips
bolero build internal/abi

-- windows-amd64 --
GOOS=windows
GOARCH=amd64

-- ios-arm64 --
GOOS=ios
GOARCH=arm64

-- linux-mips --
GOOS=linux
GOARCH=mips
